snippet.title: Semut Api Vs Kelabang
snippet.description:
Semut api (Solenopsis invicta) yang mengunci pergerakan lipan raksasa menarik perhatian para pencinta sains. Meskipun ukurannya sangat kontras, semut mungil ini memanfaatkan cengkeraman mandibelnya pada bagian ekor lipan sebagai jangkar alami untuk menahan laju sang predator. 

​Fenomena ini dijelaskan secara ilmiah melalui studi biomekanika serangga. Persendian leher dan artikulasi rangka luar (exoskeleton) semut api memiliki struktur khusus yang sangat elastis sekaligus kokoh. Anatomi ini memungkinkan persendian tubuhnya menahan tekanan mekanis masif hingga 3.000 kali berat tubuhnya sendiri tanpa mengalami kerusakan fisik. 

​Kombinasi antara kekuatan persendian, penguncian otot mandibel, serta gaya gesek kaki pada permukaan lantai menjadikan semut api sebagai salah satu serangga dengan efisiensi tenaga paling tangguh di alam raya.

snippet.title: بترفع راسه لفوق وقت النزيف؟ إنت كده بتخنقه! 😱
snippet.description:

1. إمالة الرأس للأمام قليلاً (للسماح للدم بالخروج وعدم بلعه).
2. الضغط بقوة على الجزء الطري من الأنف (أرنبة الأنف) لمدة 10 دقائق متواصلة.
3. وضع كمادات ثلج على الأنف لتضييق الأوعية الدموية وتسريع وقف النزيف

മക്കയിലെ കഅബയ്ക്ക് ചുറ്റും ലക്ഷക്കണക്കിന് മനുഷ്യർ ഒരു സെക്കൻഡ് പോലും നിർത്താതെ ഇടത്തോട്ട് മാത്രം (Counter-Clockwise) ത്വവാഫ് ചെയ്യുന്നത് എന്തിനാണ്? വെറുമൊരു ചടങ്ങെന്നതിനപ്പുറം, മനുഷ്യന്റെ ഹൃദയവും പ്രപഞ്ചത്തിന്റെ താളവും തമ്മിൽ ഇതിനെങ്ങനെ ബന്ധപ്പെട്ടു കിടക്കുന്നു?
പ്രപഞ്ചത്തിലെ സകല സൃഷ്ടികളും അല്ലാഹുവിന് തസ്ബീഹ് ചൊല്ലുന്നതിനെക്കുറിച്ച് വിശുദ്ധ ഖുർആൻ പറഞ്ഞതും, ആറ്റങ്ങൾ മുതൽ ഗാലക്സികൾ വരെയുള്ള ചലനങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ച് ആധുനിക ശാസ്ത്രം കണ്ടെത്തിയതും തമ്മിലുള്ള അതിശയിപ്പിക്കുന്ന ഒത്തുപോകലുകളാണ് ഈ വീഡിയോയിൽ പങ്കുവെക്കുന്നത്. കഅബയിലെ നിർഭയത്വവും ത്വവാഫ് ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ മനുഷ്യന്റെ തലച്ചോറിൽ ഉണ്ടാകുന്ന അതിശയിപ്പിക്കുന്ന സമാധാനവും തമ്മിലുള്ള ശാസ്ത്രീയ വശം അറിയാൻ വീഡിയോ പൂർണ്ണമായും കാണുക! നിങ്ങളുടെ ചിന്തകൾ താഴെ കമന്റ് ചെയ്യൂ.

 References

• മനുഷ്യർ എന്തിനാണ് ത്വവാഫ് ചെയ്യുന്നത് (അഭയകേന്ദ്രവും അനുസരണയും): വിശുദ്ധ ഖുർആൻ, സൂറത്തുൽ ബഖറ (2), ആയത്ത്: 125.
• പ്രപഞ്ചത്തിലെ സകല വസ്തുക്കളുടെയും തസ്ബീഹ് (വണക്കം): വിശുദ്ധ ഖുർആൻ, സൂറത്തുൽ ഇസ്രാഅ് (17), ആയത്ത്: 44.
• കഅബ നിർഭയവും സമാധാനപരവുമായ സ്ഥലം: വിശുദ്ധ ഖുർആൻ, സൂറത്തുൽ ബഖറ (2), ആയത്ത്: 125 & സൂറത്ത് ആലു ഇംറാൻ (3), ആയത്ത്: 97.
• പ്രപഞ്ചത്തിലെ 7 ആകാശങ്ങളുടെ സൃഷ്ടിപ്പ്: വിശുദ്ധ ഖുർആൻ, സൂറത്തുൽ ബഖറ (2), ആയത്ത്: 29 & സൂറത്തുൽ മുൽക് (67), ആയത്ത്: 3.

Scientific References• 

ആറ്റങ്ങളുടെയും ഗാലക്സികളുടെയും ചലനം (Counter-Clockwise Rotation): ആറ്റോമിക് ഫിസിക്സ് (Electron Orbitals) & ആസ്ട്രോണമി (Galactic & Planetary Revolutions) - പ്രപഞ്ചത്തിലെ വസ്തുക്കളുടെ സ്വാഭാവികമായ ഇടത്തോട്ടുള്ള ചലനം.
• തലച്ചോറിലെ തീറ്റ തരംഗങ്ങൾ (Theta Brain Waves & Mental Peace): ന്യൂറോ സയൻസ് പഠനങ്ങൾ (Neuroscience research on brainwave changes during deep meditation and spiritual circumambulation).
• ജനത്തിരക്കിന്റെ ഒഴുക്ക് (Fluid Dynamics in Crowd Management): ഫിസിക്സ് പഠനങ്ങൾ (Studies on Crowd Control and Fluid Flow models during Tawaf).

GUBERNUR BALI WAYAN COSTER DIKASIH PAHAM PEMILIK SPBU⁉️ #beritaterkini #trending #fyp #shortsvideo #shorts 





Krisis distribusi BBM di Bali memunculkan persoalan baru bagi para petugas SPBU yang harus melayani antrean panjang, bahkan ketika jam operasional diperpanjang hingga 24 jam.

Pemilik SPBU di kawasan Renon, Denpasar, mengungkapkan bahwa jumlah pegawainya terbatas dan sebagian sudah kelelahan. Ia meminta dukungan pemerintah, termasuk bantuan personel TNI-Polri, agar pelayanan tetap berjalan dengan baik.

Sebelumnya, Gubernur Bali Wayan Koster menjadi sorotan setelah terjadi adu argumen dengan petugas SPBU yang mengeluhkan kelelahan. Koster kemudian menjelaskan bahwa ia meminta pelayanan kepada konsumen tetap berjalan dan menyebut personel TNI akan membantu operasional pada malam hari.

Persoalan ini pun memunculkan diskusi tentang pentingnya menjaga kelancaran distribusi BBM sekaligus memperhatikan kondisi para pekerja di lapangan.

Bölüm Özeti;
Derin ve Mehmet’in mutluluğu, aileler arasındaki yıllardır küllenmeyen hesapların yeniden açılmasıyla gölgelenir. Sitare ve Feryal arasındaki gerilim giderek büyürken, Hatun iki tarafı uzlaştırmak için kolları sıvar. Ancak geçmişin yükü, gençlerin aşkını bir kez daha zor bir sınavın eşiğine getirir. Derin ve Mehmet ise aşklarını kurtarmak için herkesi şaşırtacak bir karar alır.

Dizi Özeti;
İstanbul’un köklü ve varlıklı ailelerinden birinin torunu olan Derin, hayatını belirli bir plana göre yaşamaya çalışan, evlenip yuva kurmayı en büyük hedefi haline getirmiş genç bir kadındır. Ancak uzun süredir devam eden ilişkisine rağmen bir türlü gerçekleşmeyen düğün hazırlıkları ve ailesinin bitmek bilmeyen beklentileri, onu her geçen gün daha fazla baskı altına almaktadır. Diğer tarafta ise yıllardır yurt dışında yaşayan Mehmet, ailevi sebeplerle Türkiye’ye döner. Başarılı, kendi ayakları üzerinde duran ve hayatını alıştığı düzende sürdürmek isteyen Mehmet’in dönüşü, ailesi için yeni umutların başlangıcı olur. Özellikle annesi, oğlunun artık ülkesine, ailesine ve kuracağı yeni hayata bağlanmasını istemektedir. Bunun için oğluna bir gelin adayı bile bulmuştur. Tam bu dönemde Mehmet’in kardeşi Murat’ın evlilik hazırlıkları, Derin’in hayatında hiç beklemediği kapıları aralar. Murat’ın nişanlısı ve ailesiyle, Derin arasında geçmişe dayanan gerilimler, iki ailenin yollarını kesiştirirken, yıllardır gizli kalmış duyguların ve hesapların da yeniden gündeme gelmesine neden olur. Bambaşka dünyalara ait gibi görünen Mehmet ve Derin’in yolları, ailelerin beklentileri, geçmişten gelen yükler, sırlar, yanlış anlaşılmalar ve sürpriz karşılaşmalar eşliğinde kesişmeye başlar.

Tuzlu Kahve, aşkın sadece iki insan arasında değil, aileler, gelenekler ve hayatın dayattığı beklentiler arasında da sınandığı; romantik komedi ile aile dramasını iç içe geçiren sıcak, eğlenceli ve duygusal bir hikâye anlatmaktadır.

The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. snippet.title: Yemen war hinges on Saudi Arabia's 'pain tolerance', analyst says
snippet.description:
Egypt's parliament is meeting to decide whether the country will formally support Saudi Arabia in its fight against Yemen's Ansar Allah Houthis.
On Saturday, Egypt's President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi asked parliament to approve his call to provide defensive aid.
It comes after weeks of Houthi strikes, targeting Saudi infrastructure, including multiple attacks on Riyadh's King Khalid airport that killed at least 17 people.

Talha Abdulrazaq, Middle East security expert, tells Al Jazeera that Egypt could support Saudi Arabia in the Red Sea, but says the Yemen war hinges on Riyadh’s ability to withstand Houthi strikes.

snippet.title: How Far Will the RBI Go to Defend the Rupee? The $80 Billion Question | Indian Express Special
snippet.description:
The Indian rupee has weakened sharply against the US dollar in 2026, even as the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) deploys extraordinary measures to support the currency. From tightening foreign exchange derivative rules and raising the cost of hedging to opening a special dollar window for oil companies, the RBI is pulling multiple levers to slow the rupee’s decline.
But how much is this defence costing? A Reuters report estimates that the RBI has deployed around $75 billion to $80 billion through spot dollar sales and dollar-rupee swaps since its special measures to attract foreign currency inflows took effect in June. India had mobilised more than $140 billion through these measures.
In this Indian Express explainer, we examine why the rupee remains under pressure, how the RBI is trying to stabilise it, where the liquidity generated by its currency measures has gone, and what happens when the extraordinary defence begins to ease.
We also explain the role of India’s trade deficit, crude oil prices, foreign investor outflows and global financial conditions in determining the rupee’s value.
How far can the RBI go to defend the rupee, and at what cost?
